settings.title: Security & Sessions
settings.subtitle: Control how long people stay signed in, how many devices they can use, and when they are alerted about new sign-ins.

settings.readOnlyPermission: You can view these settings but you do not have permission to change them.

settings.saveFailed: Could not save the security settings. Please try again.

settings.managedHint: This setting is managed by the platform and cannot be changed for your organization.
settings.enforcedHint: Your saved value is no longer allowed by the platform, so the platform value is used. Choose the platform default or a new value to fix it.

errors.range: Enter a whole number between {min} and {max}.
errors.serverInvalid: One of the values is not allowed. Check the highlighted fields.

password.title: Change password
password.changeHint: Enter your current password, then choose a new one. You will stay signed in on this device; all your other devices will be signed out.
password.policyHint: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number.

errors.weak: Choose a stronger password: at least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number.
errors.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.same: The new password must be different from the current one.
errors.locked: Too many failed attempts. The account is temporarily locked; try again later.
errors.failed: Could not change the password. Please try again.

sessions.title: Where you are signed in
sessions.hint: These are the devices currently signed in to your account. Sign out any device you do not recognize, then change your password.

sessions.revokeFailed: Could not sign out. Please try again.

account.title: Account security
account.subtitle: Manage your password and the devices signed in to your account.

tenantSessions.subtitle: See who is signed in, on which device, and sign people out when needed.
